::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What the builder does

The builder verifies the declared release-stamped CVD event and mortality CSVs
against their website mirrors, freezes complete copies inside the dated report
package and instantiates the central Quarto/Observable template. It never reads
a mutable `*_current.csv` file.

## Run from the Stata menu

Choose:

**User > BNR > Rolling three-month CVD update > Build dated online update**

Enter the report period, the event and mortality source releases, and a positive
report version. For a new period, leave replacement off. A correction must use
a strictly higher version and explicit replacement authorisation.

## Command-line form

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do" ///
    REPORT_YEAR REPORT_MONTH EVENT_YEAR EVENT_MONTH ///
    MORTALITY_YEAR MORTALITY_MONTH REPORT_VERSION [replace]
```

## Check the result

Confirm that:

- the run summary identifies the intended report and both source releases;
- `data/event_release.csv` and `data/mortality_release.csv` exist in the dated
  package and are complete snapshots;
- the generated `index.qmd` identifies the same version and releases;
- the report uses the central template rather than a copied earlier instance;
- no protected or unavailable component has been inferred; and
- the dated page renders before the website change is deployed.

The generated page is an instance, not a new template. Change future design in
`scripts/stata/reporting/templates/bnr_report_update_template.qmd` and rebuild.
